data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 18.1m was experienced in 2017 (2016: GBP 8.6m deficit). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business (2016: GBP 14.1m deficit) and a GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2016: GBP 5.5m surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net surplus run-off in 2017 of GBP 18.1m (a release of reserves). This comprised a GBP 22.5m favourable movement on prior year direct business claims provisions partially offset by a GBP 4.4m adverse movement on reinsurance accepted business, resulting in an overall release of approximately 6.6% of the opening gross claims outstanding balance (opening gross claims outstanding GBP 275.5m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is taken from the explicit note stating a surplus run-off of GBP 18.1m (page 35). The gross claims development triangle exists but, when excluding the aggregate 'All prior years' column and the two most recent underwriting years, the triangle shows negligible movement compared with the stated run-off sentence. The direct business surplus (GBP 22.5m) is reported at an aggregated direct level; mapping that movement to a single standard LOB required inference (direct lines encompass Property and Casualty). Lob movements therefore include an inferred mapping for direct business with reduced confidence.
